title: Request
description: A request for the harness to run: a route to record, a landing test, a control, or an inject test.

Start.description: How the run reaches its first step.

BootStart.description: A start from the boot, with nothing loaded.

from.description: new-game: the main menu's New Game, then the first step's load. booted: the disc boots straight into the first step's scene.

SaveStart.description: A start from a save in the harness's save library, loaded through the main menu's Load Game. Since schema_version 3.

save.description: The save's name in the library. The first step is the scene it loads into.

Menu.description: Where the pause menu warps to a step: its world and task slot, numbered from 1 as the menu numbers them.

CheatName.description: A cheat a step enters, by name. The platform profile gives each name its bit in the cheat mask.

menu.description: Where the pause menu warps to the step. Every step but the first has one; the start loads the first.

costumes.description: The tags of the player archives the step's load wears, at most one per character; none when left out.

cheats.description: The cheats entered while the step's level is in play.

Steps.description: The scenes to load, in order.

Windows.description: How long a test step is watched. Each left out takes the harness's default.

render.description: From the first stale write, or a control's draw. Default: 20 s of guest frames.

reset.description: From the first reset. Default: 15 s of guest frames.

write_timeout.description: From players done, the longest wait for the first stale write or for control. Default: 120 wall seconds.

Recipe.description: The recorded load whose requests place the landing, as bowlbuster place addresses it.

recording.description: The recording's folder, relative to the harness's recordings root, with forward slashes.

segment.description: The segment that holds the load.

Expected.description: The window checked at players done before anything is written.

offset.description: Where the window starts, counted from S.

bytes.description: The bytes the window holds in the recipe's cutoff capture. Their count is the window's length.

LandingTest.description: A landing placed at one step of the route.

step.description: The index of the target step.

op.description: The block's position in the recipe load's request list.

delta.description: The signed byte offset of S in the block.

min_match.description: The fraction of the expected window that must match. Default: 0.9.

ControlTest.description: A step watched as a landing test's would be, with nothing placed.

step.description: The index of the target step.

InjectTest.description: Injections applied to the loads of a scene, starting at one step of the route.

step.description: The index of the target step, whose load is injected first.

first_visit_only.description: Inject the target step's load only, not the later loads of its scene. Default: false.

RecordRequest.description: A route to drive and record, load by load.

client.description: An opaque value the harness returns unread.

LandingRequest.description: A route to a target step, a landing placed there, and an exit step after it.

tests.description: The one test the request runs.

client.description: An opaque value the harness returns unread.

ControlRequest.description: A route to a target step, watched with nothing placed, and an exit step after it.

tests.description: The one test the request runs.

client.description: An opaque value the harness returns unread.

InjectRequest.description: A route to a target step, injections written there, and an exit step after it.

tests.description: The one test the request runs.

client.description: An opaque value the harness returns unread.
